about: Provider rules in words. The console (ProviderRulesText.ts) and the faxbot command (cli/commands/rules.py) must both produce each sentence exactly. Every condition, action and setting appears at least once.

cases.sentence: When the destination country is United Kingdom, try Sinch (UK), then Telnyx.
For every fax, use the cheapest reliable of Telnyx and HumbleFax. Pages per sheet: as the receiving machine allows.
When the destination country is United Kingdom or Ireland, never use HumbleFax.
When the fax has more than 20 pages, hold the fax for approval by someone other than the sender.
When the fax is labelled legal, change nothing. Faxbot always dials the number the sender gave.
When the destination country is United Kingdom and the fax is sent from Leeds office, use the sender's site's accounts, cheapest reliable first. If every line is busy, Faxbot uses the next account.
When the number is in Northern England, use Leeds office's accounts, in order. If every line is busy, Faxbot waits for a free line.
When the number is +441782684953 and the number is in UK clinics or Hospitals and the number starts with +4420 or +4421, use Leeds trunk (Gamma).
When the number is one of 4 numbers, choose the cheapest reliable route, as before.
When the number has a verified partner, send only by direct delivery to a verified partner.
When the fax is labelled clinical or legal, send only encrypted (direct delivery, or SSL Fax where this number has used it before).

When the number has no verified partner and the number is one of your own numbers and the recipient has an approved alternate number and the destination is outside the sender's site's country, place a real call, even to your own numbers.
When the number is not one of your own numbers and the recipient has no approved alternate number and the destination is in the sender's site's country, use direct delivery.
When the recipient has an approved alternate number, use Telnyx. Faxbot dials the recipient's approved alternate number when there is one.
When the fax is part of Referrals, use Telnyx. Faxbot dials only the recipient's approved alternate number, and holds the fax when there is none.
When the sender is Ada Admin or Nia New and the fax comes from the key Front desk scanner and the sender is in Billing or Legal and the fax is sent from the mailbox Leeds intake, use HumbleFax.
When the fax is sent from Leeds office or York office and the fax is part of Referrals or Claims, never use Telnyx or HumbleFax.
When the fax has fewer than 3 pages and the file is larger than 5 MB and the fax is a case packet, use only routes that cost at most $0.50 for the fax.
When the fax has more than 1 page and the file is larger than 2.5 MB and the fax is not a case packet, hold the fax for approval.
When the fax is marked urgent and the sender did not ask for a real call, use Sinch (UK). Pages per sheet: one.
When the fax is not marked urgent and the sender asked for a real call, use delivery inside Faxbot.
When the fax is sent on weekdays between 18:00 and 07:00, use Telnyx.
When the fax is sent at weekends (the sender's site's time), use Telnyx.
When the fax is sent every day after 09:00, use Telnyx.
When the fax is sent on Monday, Wednesday and Friday before 12:00, use Telnyx.
For every fax, send the fax only on weekdays between 18:00 and 07:00 (the sender's site's time).
When the destination country is United States, unless the fax is labelled billing, never use Sinch (UK) and use only routes that cost at most $1.25 for the fax.
For every fax, unless the number is one of your own numbers, use HumbleFax.
When the number is in gone-list and the sender is an unknown person, use gone-account.
